facts.title: Gradient Generator – Free Animated 3D Gradient Backgrounds | NEAT
facts.description: Free gradient generator for animated backgrounds. Design a moving 3D gradient with 25 presets and live preview, then export to code, PNG or MP4.
facts.keywords: neat, gradient generator, 3D gradients, animated gradients, background generator, hero background, CSS gradients, web design tool, gradient animation, WebGL, react gradient

research.name: NEAT
research.note: WebGL animated 3D gradient background library with a browser editor that exports code, PNG or MP4.

effects: Animated 3D mesh gradient on plane, sphere, torus, cylinder or ribbon shapes
Iridescence, prism edges, bloom and film grain post-processing
Image color extractor for gradient palettes

unverified: The source is public at github.com/FireCMSco/neat under MIT + Commons Clause; research that repository instead.
Pricing is freemium per the repository's PRODUCT.md: free with a NEAT watermark, or a one-off licence key removes it.
